snippet.title: Delving The Depths RPG Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for the Delving The Depths dungeon crawler (DRPG) recorded in November 2026. This is an oldschool party-based RPG in the vein of The Bard's Tale, Wizardry 5, and Might and Magic 2.

The game is in development with a demo available to play and wishlist on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571080/Delving_The_Depths/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=dd&utm_content=newdtdtrailer .

Background music by Bloodless Mushroom.
